# Delta Ground Maintenance System

Delta is the ground sustainment and mission-turnaround segment for the UAS Weapon System. It performs diagnostics, software loading, post-flight HUMS collection, and readiness verification for Alpha mission systems.

Delta exchanges mission-load manifests, software baseline verification records, and readiness status with Bravo so mission-package release decisions include maintenance-derived risk information.

Maintenance operations remain ground-only and isolated from flight RF paths. All maintenance commands and software loads are authenticated, audited, and bounded to the maintenance trust boundaries.
